accept.name: fly_run
accept.cmd: rm -rf build/dp/PF-12/f; MARKS= /home/greg/deltaplan/tools/dp lock gpu PF-12 --timeout 3600 -- tools/bench/frame_profile.sh build/dp/PF-12/f medium ongudai --sample=2 >/dev/null 2>&1; ls build/dp/PF-12/f/medium_ongudai_fly.jsonl

accept.name: hitch_after2s_all
